children.text: Our High School program focuses on university and career readiness. Students receive individualized support to pursue pathways aligned with their future goals. A wide selection of electives and advanced courses, including AP programs, ensures that students can explore specialized interests.

As an accredited AP College Board, IELTS, and SAT testing centre, we prepare students thoroughly for academic success beyond school. Daily schedules also include lab-based science, design and technology, computer-based learning, and volunteering opportunities, all aligned with graduation requirements and personal development.

children.text: The curriculum enables the students to pursue a personalized pathway. Advanced Placement (AP) courses, elective options, and career guidance prepare students for university and beyond. College and career readiness, entrepreneurship, interdisciplinary learning, and leadership programs define our high school model.

children.text: High School Pathways function like college majors, but begin during the high school experience. Every student can benefit from selecting and following a sequence of career-related classes aligned with their interests.

children.text: Advanced Placement (AP) is a College Board program that allows high school students to take courses that can earn college credits and/or qualify them for advanced university classes. AP courses are weighted (1.25) provided students achieve qualifying scores on the respective College Board Exam.
AP classes are optional. All enrolled students must sit for the College Board AP exam and cover the cost of required resources and exams.
